tests.title: External domain federation is restricted, not fully open
Communication with unmanaged consumer Teams/Skype accounts is blocked
The Teams client's tenant-wide guest access toggle is a reviewed, deliberate setting
Unsanctioned third-party cloud storage providers are disabled in the Teams client
Guest meeting capabilities are limited to what's required
The global meeting policy does not auto-admit anonymous or unknown external participants
Meeting recording retention is bounded, not set to never expire
Third-party Teams app installation is governed by an explicit allow-list
